philosophy.title: How I Approach Software Engineering
philosophy.description: I enjoy designing backend systems that continue to work when reality doesn't go according to plan. For me, writing code is only one part of engineering; understanding failure, scale and operational behavior is where the real work begins.

systems.title: Dynamic Payment Gateway Routing
systems.summary: Designed a dynamic routing engine that selected the most reliable payment gateway using live success-rate metrics instead of static configurations.
systems.problem: Static routing continued sending traffic to payment gateways even when their success rates degraded, increasing failed collections and requiring operational intervention.
systems.solution: Built a routing service that continuously evaluated gateway health using Redis-backed rolling success-rate calculations and automatically selected the best available gateway for every payment request.
decisions: Maintained rolling gateway success metrics inside Redis.
Separated routing logic from payment orchestration.
Used configurable success-rate thresholds instead of hardcoded routing.
Allowed automatic gateway recovery once performance stabilized.
challenges: Handling gateway degradation without impacting users.
results: Reduced dependency on manual gateway selection.
Provided automatic failover during gateway instability.
systems.learnings: Distributed payment routing is fundamentally a reliability problem. Small routing decisions can significantly influence system availability and customer payment success.

systems.title: Mandate Presentation Optimization
systems.summary: Optimized the mandate presentation workflow, reducing overall processing time from nearly one day to approximately 1–2 hours.
systems.problem: Mandate presentation jobs processed large batches inefficiently, delaying collections and increasing operational dependency.
systems.solution: Redesigned the processing workflow to eliminate unnecessary bottlenecks, improve execution flow, and optimize scheduling without compromising processing consistency.
decisions: Optimized batch execution strategy.
Reduced unnecessary sequential processing.
Improved scheduling efficiency.
Maintained consistency across large processing batches.
challenges: Ensuring no mandate presentations were skipped.
Maintaining data consistency while increasing throughput.
results: Reduced processing time from nearly one day to approximately 1–2 hours.
systems.learnings: Performance improvements often come from redesigning execution flow rather than simply adding more infrastructure.

systems.title: Reliable Repayment Processing
systems.summary: Improved repayment reliability by designing safe processing flows capable of handling duplicate callbacks and concurrent payment events.
systems.problem: Payment providers may retry callbacks or send duplicate notifications, creating the risk of processing the same repayment multiple times.
systems.solution: Implemented validation and controlled processing flows that ensured repayments remained consistent even when duplicate events or retries occurred.
decisions: Validated every incoming repayment request before processing.
Designed processing flow to tolerate duplicate events safely.
Separated business validation from payment execution.
Maintained consistent repayment state transitions.
systems.learnings: Financial systems must assume every external callback can be delayed, duplicated, or arrive out of order.

systems.title: Corporate Bonds Investment Platform
systems.summary: Developed backend services supporting corporate bond investment workflows while maintaining secure and reliable financial operations.
systems.problem: Investment operations required reliable backend services capable of handling business workflows while maintaining secure transaction processing.
systems.solution: Designed and maintained backend APIs supporting corporate bond operations, integrating business workflows with secure service communication.
decisions: Designed modular service boundaries.
Separated business logic from API controllers.
Focused on maintainability and production stability.
Used layered architecture for extensibility.
systems.learnings: Well-defined service boundaries make complex financial systems easier to evolve while minimizing operational risk.
